decisionTree.requirementName: Password strength for non-factory default passwords

nodes.text: Is the password enforced to be set by the user before or on first use and before the equipment is logically connected to a network?
Is the password defined by an authorized entity within a network where access is limited to authorised entities?
Is the password generated by the equipment using best practice concerning strength and only communicated to an authorized entity within a network where access is limited to authorised entities?
Setting a non-factory default password is enforced securely.
The password is set by an authorized entity over a limited access network.
The equipment correctly generates and communicates a strong password to authorized entities only.
The non-factory password setting process is insecure and violates best practices.
